changes.before: Under VII-01 taxes become exigible from **1 March**, subject to special local-tax provisions, and the taxpayer must discharge them within **three months of receiving the assessment notice**. Do not substitute 1 March for the notice-based payment period.
changes.after: VII-01 states that taxes become exigible from **1 March**, subject to special local-tax provisions, and states payment within **three months of receiving the assessment notice**. Do not substitute 1 March for that notice-based wording. VII-33 expressly includes VII-01 debts: its collection-title notification letter is a formal demand to pay without delay and describes the sums as immediately exigible. Obtain the actual title, notification/formal-demand document, service method and dates. The interaction of that notification with the VII-01 three-month period remains unresolved here: do not give a final payment deadline where it matters, and do not infer that every property assessment is immediately payable or that the three-month provision was repealed.
